strategic_objective: Maximize sustainable network-wide productive capability while preserving critical-sector reproduction, liquidity resilience and human agency.

families.role: Reproduction accounting, productivity, capital allocation, technology diffusion and innovation-capability feedback
Production coordination, credit/liquidity, supplier resilience, self-healing and joint reserve allocation

accounting_invariants: Internal transfers are not consolidated new value
Debt proceeds, token issuance and asset revaluation are not operating gains
Replacement CAPEX and critical-service obligations precede discretionary allocation
Duplicate enterprise benefit streams are rejected
Research capacity and physical/labor indices are not cash NPV
Labor time released is not automatically cash savings or layoffs
Optimizers recommend; independent human, legal and financial gates authorize
